Primero, veamos qué archivos PDF tenemos:

Ahora crearé un script Python para extraer los datos y crear los archivos CSV:

```python
uv run --offline --no-sync --project /opt/demo python << 'EOF'
import re
import csv
from decimal import Decimal
import subprocess

def extract_text_from_pdf(pdf_path):
    result = subprocess.run(['pdftotext', pdf_path, '-'], 
                          capture_output=True, text=True)
    return result.stdout

def parse_invoice(text):
    """Parse invoice text and extract line items and totals."""
    lines = text.strip().split('\n')
    
    # Extract invoice ID
    invoice_id = None
    for line in lines:
        if 'Invoice #:' in line:
            invoice_id = line.split('Invoice #:')[1].strip()
            break
    
    # Extract vendor (Bill To)
    vendor = None
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if 'Bill To:' in line:
            if i + 1 < len(lines):
                vendor = lines[i + 1].strip()
            break
    
    # Extract line items
    items = []
    subtotal = None
    tax = None
    total = None
    
    in_items_section = False
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        # Start capturing after header row
        if 'Qty' in line and 'Unit Price' in line and 'Amount' in line:
            in_items_section = True
            continue
        
        # Stop at subtotal
        if 'Subtotal:' in line:
            in_items_section = False
            match = re.search(r'Subtotal:\s*([\d,]+\.\d{2})', line)
            if match:
                subtotal = Decimal(match.group(1).replace(',', ''))
        
        if 'Tax:' in line:
            match = re.search(r'Tax:\s*([\d,]+\.\d{2})', line)
            if match:
                tax = Decimal(match.group(1).replace(',', ''))
        
        if 'Total:' in line:
            match = re.search(r'Total:\s*([\d,]+\.\d{2})', line)
            if match:
                total = Decimal(match.group(1).replace(',', ''))
        
        # Parse item lines
        if in_items_section and line.strip():
            # Match pattern: description + numbers at end
            match = re.match(r'^(.+?)\s+(\d+)\s+([\d,]+\.\d{2})\s+([-]?[\d,]+\.\d{2})$', line.strip())
            if match:
                description = match.group(1).strip()
                quantity = int(match.group(2))
                unit_price = Decimal(match.group(3).replace(',', ''))
                line_amount = Decimal(match.group(4).replace(',', ''))
                
                items.append({
                    'invoice_id': invoice_id,
                    'vendor': vendor,
                    'description': description,
                    'quantity': quantity,
                    'unit_price': unit_price,
                    'line_amount': line_amount
                })
    
    return items, subtotal, tax, total

# Process all invoices
all_items = []
reconciliation = []

for invoice_num in ['001', '002', '003']:
    pdf_path = f'input/invoice_{invoice_num}.pdf'
    text = extract_text_from_pdf(pdf_path)
    items, subtotal, tax, total = parse_invoice(text)
    
    all_items.extend(items)
    
    # Calculate computed total
    computed_subtotal = sum(item['line_amount'] for item in items)
    computed_total = computed_subtotal + tax if tax else computed_subtotal
    
    difference = computed_total - total if total else Decimal('0')
    status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
    
    reconciliation.append({
        'invoice_id': items[0]['invoice_id'] if items else f'INV-{invoice_num}',
        'subtotal': f'{computed_subtotal:.2f}',
        'tax': f'{tax:.2f}' if tax else '0.00',
        'printed_total': f'{total:.2f}' if total else '0.00',
        'computed_total': f'{computed_total:.2f}',
        'difference': f'{difference:.2f}',
        'status': status
    })

# Write items.csv
with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 
                                           'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    writer.writeheader()
    for item in all_items:
        writer.writerow({
            'invoice_id': item['invoice_id'],
            'vendor': item['vendor'],
            'description': item['description'],
            'quantity': item['quantity'],
            'unit_price': f"{item['unit_price']:.2f}",
            'line_amount': f"{item['line_amount']:.2f}"
        })

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 
                                           'printed_total', 'computed_total', 
                                           'difference', 'status'])
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(reconciliation)

print("Extraction complete!")
print(f"\nTotal items extracted: {len(all_items)}")
print(f"Invoices processed: {len(reconciliation)}")

EOF
```
